invoice.name: Free Invoice & Quotation Generator for Jamaica
invoice.description: Create invoices and quotations in JMD or other currencies. Add line items, discounts and optional tax, then print or save as PDF. Free, no account needed.
invoice.heading: Create a Jamaican dollar invoice or quotation online
invoice.intro: Prepare a quotation for a customer, then create an invoice when the work is agreed. This free invoice maker supports JMD, USD, CAD, GBP and EUR for sole traders and small businesses in Jamaica and beyond.
steps: Choose Invoice or Quotation, currency, reference and date.
Add your business, customer and line items; review any discount, tax and payment instructions.
Check the preview, then print or save as PDF. Save locally or download a JSON backup if you want to reuse the document.

faq.q: Can I create an invoice in JMD and save it as PDF?
faq.a: Yes. Choose JMD, complete your document and use Print / Save PDF. Your browser provides the PDF destination. The finished document includes the LearnTech credit.

faq.q: Does it calculate my tax obligations?
faq.a: No. You choose any applicable tax rate and must check that the document meets your business and customer requirements. The tool calculates the entries you provide; it is not an accounting or tax-advice service.

faq.q: Do I need to email my customer details?
faq.a: No. Creating, printing and downloading work without email. Local saves stay in this browser profile, so keep a JSON backup and avoid saving sensitive documents on a shared device.

invoice.example: Illustrative quotation: a designer supplies three social-media banners at JMD 5,000 each. Enter quantity 3 and rate 5,000; with no discount or tax selected, the total is JMD 15,000. Replace these sample values with your own agreed prices and applicable tax settings.

website.name: Free Website Health Checker Online
website.description: Check a public page for HTTPS, mobile setup, search information and image markup. Get practical website health observations and download a free report.
website.heading: Check website basics before planning your next update
website.intro: Use this free website checker to get a first look at one public page. It helps Jamaican business owners and website managers ask clearer questions about their site, without needing an account.
steps: Enter the public page address without a login, query string or private information.
Review the observations and suggested next steps for search information, mobile setup, image markup and selected headers.
Download the report and discuss the findings with your developer. Use the linked PageSpeed Insights service for a separate performance assessment.

faq.q: Is this a complete security or speed audit?
faq.a: No. It checks one public HTML page and selected response headers. It does not test for exploitable vulnerabilities, measure all visitor experiences or crawl the whole website.

faq.q: Can it verify my PHP version or website backups?
faq.a: A PHP version is visible only when the server exposes a relevant header, which may be absent or misleading. Website backups cannot be verified publicly; ask your developer for a recent backup and evidence of a successful restore test.

faq.q: How is it different from the SEO checker?
faq.a: The website health report covers broader public-page observations. The SEO checker focuses on page titles, descriptions, headings, canonical addresses, indexing directives and image alternative attributes.

website.example: Start with your public business homepage. Review the HTTPS, mobile setup and image-markup observations, then download the report for your developer. A public-page check cannot confirm whether backups exist or prove the installed PHP version.

seo.name: Free SEO Checker — Page Titles, Meta Tags & More
seo.description: Check on-page SEO basics: titles, meta descriptions, headings, canonical URLs, indexing directives and image alt attributes. Get a free page-level report.
seo.heading: Check on-page SEO essentials in one public page
seo.intro: This free SEO checker helps you spot missing page information before asking for a website update. It is useful for business websites in Jamaica and elsewhere, whether you manage the site yourself or work with a developer.
steps: Enter the public page you want to review, such as a service or product page.
Read each observation about titles, meta descriptions, headings, canonical URLs, indexing directives and image alt attributes.
Download the report, make relevant improvements and check the page again. Use Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools to inspect actual indexing.

faq.q: Will a good report guarantee Google rankings?
faq.a: No. These are presence checks, not a ranking score. They do not measure keyword demand, backlinks, competition, writing quality or actual indexing. A present title or alt attribute can still need improvement.

faq.q: Does this check every page on my website?
faq.a: No. Submit each important public page separately. Different service and product pages should describe their own content accurately rather than repeat the same title and description.

seo.example: Check a service page rather than only your homepage. Review its title, description, headings, canonical address and image alt attributes. Repeat for other important pages; these checks identify on-page basics, not your position in Google results.

image.name: Free Image Compressor, Resizer & Converter Online
image.description: Compress, resize and convert JPEG, PNG and WebP images in your browser. Choose dimensions, crop or fit, preview and download. No upload or account needed.
image.heading: Resize, compress and convert images for websites and social posts
image.intro: Prepare a product photo, website banner or social post without uploading it. The free image converter accepts still JPEG, PNG and WebP files and exports those same formats, with a visible LearnTech credit strip.
steps: Choose a still JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 20 MB and 24 megapixels.
Select a preset or custom dimensions, choose fit or centre crop, and set JPEG or WebP quality if needed.
Create a preview, compare the file size and check the crop before downloading the finished image.

faq.q: Can I convert PNG to JPEG or JPEG to WebP?
faq.a: Yes. Select your source image and choose the download format. JPEG uses a white background. PNG and WebP can keep transparency when you select that option.

faq.q: Can this convert an image to SVG?
faq.a: For logos and icons, use the separate SVG converter linked below. It traces raster shapes into vector paths. This image resizer still accepts and exports JPEG, PNG and WebP only; putting a bitmap inside an SVG wrapper would not make it a true vector image.

faq.q: Will compression always make my file smaller?
faq.a: No. Format changes, output dimensions and the LearnTech credit can increase file size. Review the size shown in the preview. Enlarging a small image does not create extra detail.

image.example: Prepare a product photo for your online catalogue: choose the target width, fit the full photo or crop to the required shape, then compare JPEG and WebP output sizes. Review the preview and LearnTech credit strip before downloading.

brandsnap.name: Add Logo & Text to Photos Online — Free BrandSnap
brandsnap.description: Add your logo and text to photos with free BrandSnap. Choose logo placement, text banners and social-post sizes. Download JPEG, PNG or WebP. No upload.
brandsnap.heading: Add a logo and text to product photos and social posts
brandsnap.intro: BrandSnap is a free photo branding tool from LearnTech Foundation in Jamaica. Add your business logo, event name or promotional message to an image, then choose a square, portrait, story or custom canvas.
steps: Choose a photo and an optional logo. Transparent PNG logos work well.
Add your headline and message, choose banner colours and position your logo.
Choose dimensions and format, create a preview, then download. Check text contrast, crop and spelling before sharing.

faq.q: Can I add a logo without stretching it?
faq.a: Yes. BrandSnap preserves the logo proportions. You can choose its size, position and opacity, or add a white backing to help it stand out.

faq.q: Are my photos uploaded or saved online?
faq.a: No. Your selected photo, logo and text are processed in this browser. Reset clears the current session; downloaded files stay on your device. Optional camera access starts only when you press Start camera.

faq.q: Can I create Instagram or Facebook images?
faq.a: Yes. Use a square, portrait, story or custom canvas, then upload the downloaded image to your chosen platform. BrandSnap does not post to social accounts. Every download includes the LearnTech credit.

brandsnap.example: Brand a shop product photo: add your transparent PNG logo, enter a message such as New arrivals, and choose the square social-post size. Position the logo, create the preview, then download a JPEG, PNG or WebP. After editing settings, update the preview before downloading.

svg_converter.name: Free Image to SVG Converter for Logos & Icons
svg_converter.description: Trace PNG, JPEG and WebP logos into real SVG vector paths in your browser. Choose colours and detail, preview and download with LearnTech credit.
svg_converter.subtitle: Turn a simple logo or icon into scalable vector paths. Preview the trace before downloading.
svg_converter.intro: Your image stays on this device. This is vector tracing, not a bitmap placed inside an SVG wrapper. It works best for simple shapes and flat colours; photographs and small lettering may lose detail.
svg_converter.heading: Trace a simple logo
svg_converter.settings: The longest side is reduced to this limit; small images are not enlarged for tracing. Noise is simplified. More detail can mean larger, more complex SVG files. The preview uses the actual download.
svg_converter.aside: The download contains vector paths and a visible LearnTech credit footer below the artwork, plus credit in the SVG description. This changes the full canvas proportions. Review edges, lettering, colours and transparency before using it.
steps: Choose a clear JPEG, PNG or WebP logo or icon. Transparent PNG is useful for isolated artwork.
Choose the number of colours and maximum trace resolution, then create a preview.
Compare the trace with your source, adjust settings if needed, and download the SVG with its LearnTech credit footer.

faq.q: Is the download a real vector image?
faq.a: Yes. The artwork is rebuilt as SVG paths rather than embedded as a PNG or JPEG. Tracing approximates the original; it does not recover original design files or editable fonts.

faq.q: Will it work well on photos or tiny text?
faq.a: It is intended for logos and icons with simple shapes. Photos, gradients and very small text can produce poor results or many shapes. Use fewer colours, a clearer source or an original vector design when available. Semi-transparent pixels are simplified to transparent or solid, so soft shadows are not preserved.

faq.q: Can I stop a long trace?
faq.a: Yes. Use Cancel generation. The worker is terminated; your source stays ready for another attempt. A trace also stops after 45 seconds. Reset removes the image and output.

svg_converter.example: Trace a simple two-colour logo from a PNG. Choose two or four trace colours, create the SVG preview and inspect the edges and lettering. Use the vector download for supported website or design workflows; detailed photographs are better kept as raster images.

favicon.name: Free Favicon Generator — PNG & ICO ZIP Download
favicon.description: Turn a logo or photo into PNG favicons, Apple-touch and app icons, plus a multi-size ICO. Download a ZIP with installation markup and LearnTech guidance.
favicon.subtitle: Create a favicon package from your logo, ready to hand to your website developer.
favicon.intro: Generate browser and app-icon images locally, without an upload or account. Download a ZIP containing six PNG sizes, a multi-size ICO, a manifest icon template, HTML markup and a LearnTech README.
favicon.heading: Prepare your favicon package
favicon.settings: PNG sizes: 16, 32, 48, 180, 192 and 512 px. ICO includes 16, 32 and 48 px. Your image fits without stretching. A simple square logo is easier to recognise at small sizes; enlarging a small image cannot add detail.
favicon.aside: File names include your chosen brand and learntech. The ZIP includes the exact credit, contact links and installation instructions in its README, plus credit in PNG metadata and the manifest description. Tiny icon artwork stays readable without a text strip. The manifest is an icon template, not a complete installable PWA.
steps: Choose a clear logo or image, and enter a short brand name for the package.
Choose padding and a background. Preview every icon, especially the 16 px version.
Download the ZIP. Upload files to your site and follow the included README and HTML snippet, or pass them to your developer.

faq.q: What is in the favicon ZIP?
faq.a: Six PNGs at 16, 32, 48, 180, 192 and 512 pixels; one ICO containing 16, 32 and 48 pixel images; a webmanifest icon template; an HTML head snippet; and a LearnTech README with installation steps and contact details.

faq.q: Will the icons have my logo or a LearnTech watermark?
faq.a: The icon artwork uses your image. LearnTech credit is retained in branded file names, PNG metadata, the manifest description and the included README, so the tiny 16 px icon remains useful.

faq.q: Does this make my site a complete installable app?
faq.a: No. It provides icon assets and a manifest template. Your site may need additional configuration and functionality. Merge the template icons into any existing manifest and avoid duplicate manifest links.

favicon.example: Turn your business logo into browser and app icons. Leave clear space around the artwork, generate the package and inspect the small-size previews. The ZIP includes PNG sizes, a multi-size ICO, installation markup and a LearnTech README.

password_generator.name: Free Secure Password Generator Online
password_generator.description: Generate a random password locally with cryptographic browser randomness. Choose length and characters, copy or download. No account or saved password history.
password_generator.heading: Create a fresh random password for your next account
password_generator.intro: Generate a random password for a new account or password update, with options for length and character groups. Create it locally, then use your password manager to store it.
steps: Choose 8 to 128 characters and the groups your website accepts. The default is 20 characters with all groups.
Generate a password, reveal it if needed and copy it to your password manager or account form.
Clear the tool when finished. Download only if you want an unencrypted text copy on your device.

faq.q: Does LearnTech receive or save the password?
faq.a: The generator uses the browser’s cryptographic random source and keeps the result in page memory. It does not upload or save it in local storage, send it by email or include it in analytics. Reset, a new generation or leaving the page clears the displayed result. Your clipboard, downloads or password manager are separate.

faq.q: Will every website accept the generated password?
faq.a: Sites have different length and character rules. Adjust the options to the target site. Every selected character group appears in the result. Excluding ambiguous characters removes I, l, 1, O, o and 0.

faq.q: Is the text download encrypted?
faq.a: No. It is a plain-text file with a LearnTech credit and contact information. Store it securely or move the value into your password manager.

password_generator.example: For a new account, start with a 20-character password and the character groups the site accepts. Generate locally and copy it into your password manager. Use a different password for each account; download only if you need an unencrypted text copy.

qr_generator.name: Free QR Code Generator — PNG & SVG Downloads
qr_generator.description: Create a static QR code for a website URL or plain text in your browser. Preview and download PNG or SVG with LearnTech credit. No upload or account needed.
qr_generator.heading: Create a QR code for a business link or short message
qr_generator.intro: Put a website link on a flyer, product insert or business card, or encode a short text message. LearnTech’s generator makes a static black-and-white code locally, with a clear scan area and credit below it.
steps: Choose Website URL or Plain text, then enter the content to encode. Anyone scanning the shared code can read that content.
Choose the image-area size and error correction. Generate a preview; shorten dense content if the tool asks.
Download PNG or SVG and scan-test the actual file before publishing or printing. Keep the white border and credit outside the scan area.

faq.q: Does the QR code expire or use a LearnTech redirect?
faq.a: The code stores your URL or text directly. LearnTech does not host a redirect or impose a scan limit or expiry. A linked website can still change, become unavailable or restrict access.

faq.q: Can I change the destination after downloading?
faq.a: A static QR code cannot be edited after printing. Generate a new code for new content. If you control the destination website, you can update the page it points to.

faq.q: Why is there no logo over the QR code?
faq.a: The generator keeps black modules, a white background and at least four clear modules around the code. The LearnTech footer is outside that scan area. Test at the intended print size; long content makes a denser code.

faq.q: Can I encode private information?
faq.a: Processing is local, but anyone with the finished code can scan its contents. Use information you intend to share. The generator does not submit your content or decoded URL to LearnTech or analytics.

qr_generator.example: Create a code for your public contact or booking page. Paste its HTTPS address, preview the result and download SVG for a print layout or PNG for a digital post. Scan-test the actual file at its intended size before publishing.

email_signature.name: Free Email Signature Builder for Businesses
email_signature.description: Create a professional email signature with contact details, logo and social links. Copy formatted or plain text, or download HTML locally.
email_signature.heading: Create a professional signature for every business email
email_signature.intro: Build a clear introduction for your business emails, with three layouts, your brand colour and optional links.
steps: Enter your name and optional contact information. Choose a layout and brand colour.
Review the live preview, then copy formatted or plain text, or download HTML.
Paste into your email signature settings and send yourself a test message.

faq.q: Are my details saved or uploaded?
faq.a: The builder keeps your details in page memory, without saving them in local storage or sending them to LearnTech. A logo URL loads its image from that host. Copies and downloads remain on your device.

faq.q: Will it look identical in every email app?
faq.a: No. Email apps can change spacing, fonts and image display. The signature uses simple tables and inline styles; test it in your own email app. Mobile apps may accept plain text only.

faq.q: Can I use my own logo or photo?
faq.a: Choose the logo or photo layout and enter a public HTTPS image address hosted on your website. Recipients may block remote images, so your contact details also appear as text.

email_signature.example: Load the personal-photo example, choose Above text and Centre, and set a suitable photo width. Replace the sample name, role and contact links with your own, then copy the formatted signature into your email settings and send yourself a test message.

passport_photo.name: Free Passport Photo Maker — Printable Letter & A4 Sheets
passport_photo.description: Crop passport-size photos at 35 × 45 mm or a custom size. Arrange copies on Letter or A4 paper and print at actual size, without uploading your photo.
passport_photo.heading: Make a passport-size photo print sheet online
passport_photo.intro: Prepare a passport-size or ID photo, then arrange one, several or a full grid of copies on US Letter or A4 paper. The Jamaica print-size preset is 35 × 45 mm; other presets and custom dimensions are available. Processing stays in your browser.
steps: Choose a photo using the single file picker, or open the camera option and capture a photo.
For 35 × 45 mm, align the head top to the blue 3.5 mm guide, then zoom and position the chin within the green 25–35 mm face-height band. Other dimensions use a centre guide only.
Choose paper and copy count, create the sheet, then print or save PDF at 100% / Actual size. Measure a test print before cutting.
passport_photo.example: For two Jamaican-size prints, select 35 × 45 mm and two copies on Letter paper. Align the head top (including hair) with the blue 3.5 mm line and place the chin between the green lines. The red line marks the poster’s 2 mm minimum headroom. Hide the guides to review the crop; downloads omit them automatically.

faq.q: Does this guarantee an acceptable Jamaican passport photo?
faq.a: No. The tool sets dimensions and layout but does not check face measurements, lighting, background, clothing, recency, print quality or official acceptance. Check PICA’s current photo requirements and use a professional photographer when appropriate.

faq.q: How do I keep the photos the correct size when printing?
faq.a: Choose matching Letter or A4 paper, portrait orientation, 100% / Actual size, no margins and no browser headers or footers. Disable Fit to page. The PNG has a 300 DPI density tag, but print apps can override it. Measure a test photo with a ruler.

faq.q: Are my photo and camera images uploaded?
faq.a: No. Photo files and camera captures are processed in page memory on your device. Camera access starts only when requested and stops after capture, on Stop camera, when the camera panel closes or when you leave. No photo content is sent in optional analytics.

faq.q: Will the LearnTech credit cover my face or the cut-out photo?
faq.a: No. Credit and instructions appear in the sheet footer, outside the photo grid. Only the sheet is downloaded; the cut-out photo area has no watermark.
